import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import f_oneway

# Load the invasion success dataset
invasion_success = pd.read_csv('/data/invasion_success_pathways.csv')

# Filter out rows with missing values in 'mrt' and 'intro.pathway'
invasion_success = invasion_success.dropna(subset=['mrt', 'intro.pathway'])

# Group the data by 'intro.pathway' and calculate the mean mrt and invasion success metrics
grouped_data = invasion_success.groupby('intro.pathway').agg(
    mean_mrt=('mrt', 'mean'),
    mean_invaded_niche_breadth=('invaded.niche.breadth', 'mean'),
    mean_number_of_invaded_plots=('number.of.invaded.plots', 'mean'),
    mean_area_of_occupancy=('area.of.occupancy.10km', 'mean')
).reset_index()

# Display the grouped data
grouped_data

from scipy.stats import f_oneway

# Perform ANOVA to test for differences in 'mean_invaded_niche_breadth' across introduction pathways
anova_result_invaded_niche_breadth = f_oneway(
    invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == 'AgriForest']['invaded.niche.breadth'],
    invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == 'Gardening']['invaded.niche.breadth'],
    invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == 'Unintentional']['invaded.niche.breadth']
)

# Perform ANOVA to test for differences in 'mean_number_of_invaded_plots' across introduction pathways
anova_result_number_of_invaded_plots = f_oneway(
    invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == 'AgriForest']['number.of.invaded.plots'],
    invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == 'Gardening']['number.of.invaded.plots'],
    invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == 'Unintentional']['number.of.invaded.plots']
)

# Perform ANOVA to test for differences in 'mean_area_of_occupancy' across introduction pathways
anova_result_area_of_occupancy = f_oneway(
    invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == 'AgriForest']['area.of.occupancy.10km'],
    invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == 'Gardening']['area.of.occupancy.10km'],
    invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == 'Unintentional']['area.of.occupancy.10km']
)

anova_result_invaded_niche_breadth, anova_result_number_of_invaded_plots, anova_result_area_of_occupancy

import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.formula.api import ols

# Convert 'intro.pathway' to a categorical variable
invasion_success['intro.pathway'] = pd.Categorical(invasion_success['intro.pathway'])

# Fit a multiple regression model for 'invaded.niche.breadth' with 'intro.pathway' and 'mrt' as predictors
model_invaded_niche_breadth = ols('invaded.niche.breadth ~ C(intro.pathway) + mrt', data=invasion_success).fit()
anova_table_invaded_niche_breadth = sm.stats.anova_lm(model_invaded_niche_breadth, typ=2)

# Fit a multiple regression model for 'number.of.invaded.plots' with 'intro.pathway' and 'mrt' as predictors
model_number_of_invaded_plots = ols('number.of.invaded.plots ~ C(intro.pathway) + mrt', data=invasion_success).fit()
anova_table_number_of_invaded_plots = sm.stats.anova_lm(model_number_of_invaded_plots, typ=2)

# Fit a multiple regression model for 'area.of.occupancy.10km' with 'intro.pathway' and 'mrt' as predictors
model_area_of_occupancy = ols('area.of.occupancy.10km ~ C(intro.pathway) + mrt', data=invasion_success).fit()
anova_table_area_of_occupancy = sm.stats.anova_lm(model_area_of_occupancy, typ=2)

anova_table_invaded_niche_breadth, anova_table_number_of_invaded_plots, anova_table_area_of_occupancy
